valuation._note: The bridge from earnings scenarios to DECISIONS. Return_s = (exit_multiple_s x fy26e_npat_s) / market_cap_now - 1 + cash_yield. Working in market-cap space avoids share-count drift (the HPG/TCX stock-dividend trap). exit_multiple is the single biggest judgment call in this file: it is where 'what is it worth' lives. probs are Layer-2 beliefs; confidence is the evidence-quality shrink applied to expected return (see decide.py).
valuation._npat_ttm_method: DERIVED FROM THE EARNINGS PATH, not from a guessed share count: npat_ttm = H1_26 + H2_25, where H1_25 = H1_26/(1+yoy) and H2_25 ~ H1_25 x 1.05 seasonality. This keeps npat_ttm internally consistent with the same H1 actuals the scenarios are built on. An earlier version derived it from estimated share counts and put MBB's TTM base ~35% too low, which made a normal bank look like a +85% expected return. Cross-check whenever prices refresh: pe_ttm x npat_ttm should land within ~5% of shares x price.

optimizer._note: Turns expected returns into TARGET WEIGHTS. No covariance matrix exists for this book, so risk is modeled honestly: sigma from scenario dispersion blended with a base equity vol, correlation from a BLOCK model (cluster > sector > market). This makes the 20%/35% caps a cross-check on the math rather than the only risk control.

model._FEASIBILITY_2026_07_27: Independent derivation from Q1 unit economics reproduces these counts as 81/131/186 — the model is internally consistent. BUT: only 135 units are SOLD (60% of 226), so the bull branch (186) is arithmetically infeasible from contracted sales; it needs ~51 further units sold AND handed inside the same year. And Q1 delivered 6 units, so even the bear branch needs 25/quarter — a 4.2x step-up. Recommend cutting bull probability from 0.20. NOT applied: probability re-weighting is a judgment change reserved for a human (charter section 2).
model._Q2_PRE_REGISTERED_READ: Written before the print (~Jul 28-30) so it cannot be rationalised after. Parent NPAT 170bn => ~19 units handed (bear confirmed, still short of the 25/qtr bear pace); 259bn => ~27 (bear-to-base); 348bn => ~35 (base in play). Verify units two ways: Doan Nguyen/Gladia inventory movement (3.45tn at Q1, ~15bn released per handover) AND the revenue line. Customer advances (688.6bn at Q1) matter more than profit — that is the forward-looking series and the armed kill criterion.
